## Lisbon Trip Snapshot: 4 Days, €900 Budget

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg

You have a comfortable mid-range budget for 2 adults, with room for museums, seafood meals, local transit, and one slower evening. I’m assuming you’ll stay centrally in Lisbon and use a mix of walking, metro, tram, and occasional rideshare.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary with Costs and Rain Plans

### Day 1: Baixa, Chiado, and a Classic First Look
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Walk Baixa and Rossio, then head to Praça do Comércio and the riverside for an easy orientation stroll.
- Afternoon: Visit Museu Nacional do Azulejo or Museu Arqueológico do Carmo, then linger in Chiado for cafés and shops.
- Dinner: Seafood dinner in Chiado or Cais do Sodré; try grilled fish, clams, or arroz de marisco.
- Transit tip: Use the metro to Baixa-Chiado or Rossio, then walk most of the day.
- Backup indoor activity: Museu Nacional do Azulejo if weather turns wet.

Estimated cost for 2:
- Transit: €8
- Museums/entry: €20–€30
- Lunch/snacks: €30–€40
- Dinner: €70–€90
- Total: **€128–€168**

Action: [Button: Metro Routes](https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/)

### Day 2: Belém Museums and Riverfront Icons
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Start at Jerónimos Monastery area, then walk to Belém Tower and the Monument to the Discoveries.
- Afternoon: Choose one museum: Museu Nacional dos Coches or MAAT, depending on your preference for history or modern design.
- Dinner: Relaxed seafood dinner back in central Lisbon; keep this as a slightly slower evening.
- Transit tip: Tram, bus, or rideshare to Belém; walking between sights is easy once you arrive.
- Backup indoor activity: MAAT and the Coach Museum are both strong rainy-day options.

Estimated cost for 2:
- Transit: €12–€18
- Museum/entry: €25–€40
- Lunch/Pastéis stop: €20–€30
- Dinner: €70–€90
- Total: **€127–€178**

Action: [Button: Belém Info](https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/places/belem)

### Day 3: Alfama, Castelo, and a Relaxed Evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Explore Alfama on foot, with stops near Lisbon Cathedral and the castle area for views and narrow lanes.
- Afternoon: Visit Castelo de São Jorge or swap in a museum if you want less climbing.
- Dinner: Build in your one relaxed evening here; choose a long, unhurried seafood meal with wine and an early finish.
- Transit tip: Use the tram or a short rideshare uphill, then walk downhill through Alfama.
- Backup indoor activity: Museu do Fado for a cultural indoor alternative.

Estimated cost for 2:
- Transit: €10–€16
- Entry/museum: €20–€30
- Lunch/snacks: €25–€35
- Dinner: €80–€110
- Total: **€135–€191**

Action: [Button: Alfama Guide](https://www.visitlisboa.com/en/places/alfama)

### Day 4: Modern Lisbon, River Walk, and Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg
- Morning: Head to Parque das Nações for a modern contrast, with a riverside walk and light sightseeing.
- Afternoon: Choose Oceanário de Lisboa or a final museum stop, then keep the rest flexible for shopping or a café break.
- Dinner: Casual farewell seafood lunch or early dinner, depending on your departure time.
- Transit tip: Metro is the easiest way to reach Parque das Nações and the airport corridor.
- Backup indoor activity: Oceanário de Lisboa is the best all-weather fallback.

Estimated cost for 2:
- Transit: €10–€18
- Entry/museum: €30–€50
- Lunch/snacks: €25–€35
- Dinner: €50–€80
- Total: **€115–€183**

Action: [Button: Lisbon Metro](https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/)

## Budget Outlook for the Full Trip

Estimated total for 2 adults, excluding flights:
- Transit: **€40–€60**
- Museums/entries: **€95–€150**
- Food and drinks: **€375–€505**
- Buffer for taxis, extra coffee, or souvenirs: **€100–€150**
- Trip total: **€610–€865**

This keeps you within your **€900** cap with a healthy cushion for spontaneous meals or one pricier museum day.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Metro Planner](https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/)
